title: 6-Month Product Design Internship (Hamburg)
note: Only for students whose program requires an internship; English required, German a plus.

facts.summary: TEAMS Hamburg takes two product/industrial design interns per semester for six months, starting March 2027.
facts.duties: Support research, concept design, ergonomics, workshops and brand-driven design on consumer and capital-goods projects.
facts.requirements: Enrolled ID/product design student needing a compulsory internship; Photoshop, Rhino or SolidWorks, KeyShot; strong sketching and English.
facts.apply: Email cover letter, CV and process portfolio (PDF, 10-15MB max), or use the contact form.
